Type: lamp
Name: AmazonBasics Natural Himalayan Salt Lamp Bowl with Massage Balls, Wood Base with Dimmer Switch - Crystal Pink
Colors: Crystal Pink
Lamp made of crystal-pink natural Himalayan salt in a bowl shape with removable therapeutic massage balls Provides mood-boosting light, calming ambience, decorative appeal, and natural air purification Wood base with 59.1-inch power cord for versatile placement; dimmer switch allows for easily adjusting the brightness Comes fully assembled in high-quality shrink wrap (both product and box); great for gift giving; 1 extra 15-watt bulb included 110-120 volts; backed by an AmazonBasics 1-year limited warranty
